sources.title: International maritime voyages consultation accessible webpage

facts.source_fact: The Authority already confirmed a cap adjustment for domestic maritime expansion.
facts.expected_handling: Separate confirmed domestic adjustment from proposed international adjustment.

facts.source_fact: The Authority proposes a similar cap-adjustment approach for international maritime.
The proposed approach uses the latest net-zero-consistent international-maritime trajectory.
Indicative Phase I additions for 50% international coverage are 5.0 MtCO2e in 2028, 4.9 in 2029 and 4.7 in 2030.
facts.expected_handling: Label figures as indicative modelling, not final cap values.

facts.source_fact: The indicative figures are based on Maritime Decarbonisation Strategy modelling.
The consultation explicitly says these figures do not reflect a finalised policy position.
Future modelling updates may revise the indicative figures.
The UK ETS Phase I cap runs through the scheme year beginning 1 January 2030.
Phase II will run from 2031 onwards and will have a separately consulted cap trajectory.
facts.expected_handling: Do not project Phase I proposal into Phase II.

facts.source_fact: Any final international cap decision depends on further analysis and consultation.
facts.expected_handling: Require Authority Response before final status.
